meta.description: Mock landscape indicator dataset for Tigray/Amhara Highland kebele — Ethiopia use case
meta.source: LIRA-AI MVP mock data — NOT real measurements

community_context.community_preferred_future: Improved food security with maintained grazing access
community_context.local_degradation_memory: Elders report forest cover loss since 1980s; rills and gullies increasing since 2010
community_context.grazing_rules: Communal grazing on hillsides; seasonal closure agreements partly enforced
community_context.labor_constraints: High seasonal out-migration of youth; women bear water and fuelwood collection burden
community_context.gendered_burdens: Women spend 3-4 hours/day on fuelwood and water collection
community_context.youth_opportunities: Nursery and tree seedling enterprise could engage youth
community_context.local_conflict_risks: Boundary disputes with neighbouring kebele over grazing land
community_context.tenure_constraints: Hillside land has unclear tenure between forest authority and households
